findings.claim: `countdownOnScreen` and `countdownClearance` in countdown.ts are dead in src/. game.ts now passes `COUNTDOWN_HALF_WIDTH` and `countdownFraming(view)` to the scene. The only importer of these two functions is tests/render/countdown-framing.test.ts, so removing them needs the owner.
findings.evidence: src/ui/countdown.ts:20 `export function countdownOnScreen(view…)` and :47 `export const countdownClearance = (view…) => (countdownOnScreen(view) ? COUNTDOWN_HALF_WIDTH : 0);`. The src uses are src/game.ts:24 `import { COUNTDOWN_HALF_WIDTH, countdownFraming } from './ui/countdown.ts'`, :191 `r.scene.update(r.drawn, dt, COUNTDOWN_HALF_WIDTH, countdownFraming(view))` and :322 (same call). A grep over the repo finds `countdownOnScreen` and `countdownClearance` only in countdown.ts itself and in tests/render/countdown-framing.test.ts:15, :37, :54-56 and :75-76. The `countdownClearance: 5.5` in render/camera.ts:32 is an unrelated CAMERA field.
findings.suggestedFix: Owner: retarget the countdown-framing.test.ts cases to `countdownFraming` / `COUNTDOWN_HALF_WIDTH`, or inline the predicate in the test. Then delete `countdownOnScreen` and `countdownClearance` (countdown.ts:19-22 and :46-47). GO_GONE_TICKS stays, because countdownFraming uses it.

findings.claim: Converting ms to whole sim ticks (rounded up) is written out twice: once as a private helper in race-ui.ts and once inline in countdown.ts. The inverse, `ticksToMs`, already lives in format.ts.
findings.evidence:
src/ui/race-ui.ts:21 `const msToTicks = (ms: number): number => Math.ceil((ms * TICK_HZ) / 1000);`
src/ui/countdown.ts:17 `export const GO_GONE_TICKS = Math.ceil((GO_GONE_MS * TICK_HZ) / 1000);`
src/ui/format.ts:5 `export const ticksToMs = (ticks: number): number => (ticks * 1000) / TICK_HZ;`
findings.suggestedFix: Export `msToTicks` from format.ts next to `ticksToMs`, with the same expression. Import it in race-ui.ts (delete the local copy) and use `msToTicks(GO_GONE_MS)` at countdown.ts:17. The arithmetic is the same, so the values are the same.

findings.claim: The NEW BEST chip repeats the BEST chip's tuck-under declarations word for word. That is padding, no top outline, square top corners and line-height 1, matching the comment 'styled like BEST'.
findings.evidence:
src/ui/hud.css:117-125 `.ui-hud-best { … padding: var(--space-s1) var(--space-s2); border-top: 0; border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-rect) var(--radius-rect); line-height: 1; }`
src/ui/hud.css:196-200 `.ui-hud-new-best { padding: var(--space-s1) var(--space-s2); border-top: 0; border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-rect) var(--radius-rect); line-height: 1; …`
findings.suggestedFix: Move the four shared declarations into a grouped rule `.ui-hud-best, .ui-hud-new-best { … }` at the .ui-hud-best position. Keep display/align-items/gap on .ui-hud-best, and visibility/transform on .ui-hud-new-best. Both selectors are single classes with unchanged specificity. They come after .ui-panel (components.css is imported first) and before the .is-desktop overrides, so the cascade order is preserved and computed styles stay the same.

findings.claim: Several CSS comments still name the dead finish panel as the user of shared components and leave out the live pause and results screens. A feature night reading them would look in finish-panel.ts (see C012).
findings.evidence: src/ui/components.css:52 `/* Display heading: italic 900 caps (start title, FINISHED). */` — live users are start-screen.ts:23 and results-screen.ts:57; 'Finished' is only in finish-panel.ts:33. components.css:63 `(LAP, TIME, finish stats)`. components.css:77 `/* Big overlay (finish card, countdown roundel)` — live users are countdown.ts:83 and pause-screen.ts:32. screens.css:1 `/* Start screen, finish panel and the shared full-screen menu ground. */` while most of the file is the pause card (:83-136) and the stripe used by start, pause and results.
findings.suggestedFix: Comment-only edits: components.css:52 → '(start title, results track name)', :63 → '(LAP, TIME, results rows)', :77 → '(pause card, countdown roundel)', screens.css:1 → 'Start and pause screens, the triple stripe and the shared full-screen menu ground.' Leave the .ui-finish__* block's own comment for the owner's C012 removal.

confirmations.note: Unchanged. components.css:122-131 (.ui-button) and touch-controls.css:47-56 (.ui-tc) still carry the same button-type and transition block. clones.md still flags components.css:122 = touch-controls.css:47.

Unchanged. screens.css:115-126 (.ui-pause__stripes .ui-stripe flex 1 / width auto / height s3, red flex 4, mustard flex 2) and results.css:28-39 (.ui-results > .ui-stripes …) are still duplicated. Only border-width differs.
